word.definition: To hobnob is to socialize with others, especially with people of high social status.

market.headline: Heart Disease, a Historic Strength for Big Pharma, Becomes a Weakness
market.summary: Heart disease remains humanity’s top killer, yet for drugmakers and Wall Street, it is becoming one of the hardest places to make money.

quote.text: I believe in the complete freedom of thought and speech — alike for the humblest man and the mightiest, and in the utmost freedom of conduct that is consistent with living in organized society. I believe in the capacity of man to conquer his world, and to find out what it is made of, and how it is run. I believe in the reality of progress. I — But the whole thing, after all, may be put very simply. I believe that it is better to tell the truth than to lie. I believe that it is better to be free than to be a slave. And I believe that it is better to know than be ignorant.
quote.author: H. L. Mencken

history.text: Dwight Gooden sets the baseball record for strikeouts in a season by a rookie with 276, previously set by Herb Score with 246 in 1954. Gooden's 276 strikeouts that season, pitched in 218 innings, set the current record.
